verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI documents its own MCP-server integration, configured in settings.json, to extend the agent with custom tools and new capabilities. An @github example shows connecting to an external workflow service. However, nothing in the evidence shows integrations with Jira, Slack, or Google Drive specifically, so delivery of the named tools rests on the generic MCP mechanism. Missing for 10: documented Jira/Slack/Google Drive connectors or setup guides, hands-on corroboration of workflow-tool context integration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect the agent to workflow tools like Jira, Slack, and Google Drive to extend its context

citations.quote: Configure MCP servers in ~/.gemini/settings.json to extend Gemini CLI with custom tools
Use MCP servers to connect new capabilities
